meaning: A box that connects your home to your internet company. It changes the signal on the line into data your devices can use.
clues: It is a small box near the spot where your internet comes into your home.
It talks to your internet company's line, not to your phone or laptop.
The cable from the wall or the line from the company plugs into it.
Its name is short for two long words, "modulator" and "demodulator".
It has five letters and starts with M.
assumes: A router shares your internet with devices in your home
Fiber-optic cable carries data as flashes of light
A TV antenna picks up TV signals from the air

decoys.meaning: A box that shares your home's internet with your phones, TVs, and computers.
A thin strand of glass that carries data as flashes of light.
Metal rods or a flat panel that pick up TV signals from the air.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: I remember when modems screeched like robots every time they dialed. Beeeee-krrrr-shhhh!

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Tip: modern ones are quiet. If the internet is out, check the modem's lights first, then call your internet company.
